citations.quote: But they differ from the earlier models in explicitly interpreting the effectiveness of labor as knowledge and in modeling the determinants of its evolution over time.
As the phase diagram shows, the economy exhibits ever-increasing growth rather than convergence to a balanced growth path.
The position of the LRAS curve is determined by the potential output of the economy.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Romer Ch.3-4 endogenous growth (AK and R&D-based models) and cross-country convergence taxonomy: absolute (all poor catch up) vs conditional (poor converge to own steady-state fundamentals); empirical conditional convergence at ~2 percent per year.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Endogenous Growth and Convergence
